`STOP-M0-001` remains OPEN. Capital remains USD 50 conceptual, USD 0 deployable, LOCKED, with the kill switch ENGAGED. This review does not release Risk, authorize strategy work, paper/live activity or capital, or prove any external authority trustworthy.

## Q01 disposition — CLOSED locally

The successor compares the proposed holdout's canonical sample keys with every declared split of every other accepted trial whose `started_at` is no later than proposed first access. It does not rely on submitted predecessor lists or result-access presence.

| Attack | Independent result |
|---|---|
| Exact prior train, validation, test and holdout overlap | All reject at the named split's canonical-consumption check. |
| Renamed, reordered, repackaged, membership-v2 and partial overlap | All reject by canonical Data identity. |
| Split-role relabeling | Moving the same membership among roles does not evade the all-role scan. |
| FAILED, CANCELLED and ATTEMPTED trials | All reject despite null result-access evidence. |
| Trial starts immediately before first access | Rejects. |
| Trial starts exactly at first access | Rejects. |
| Trial starts immediately after first access | Permitted, matching the documented boundary. |
| Record created after first access but declaring a prior start | Fails closed once accepted into current history; it cannot manufacture eligibility. Truthful chronology and protection against malicious backdating remain external/controller concerns. |
| Omit contaminating trial by selecting old inventory | Rejects as incomplete against the authoritative current registry. |
| Reuse old accepted-state digest | Rejects as stale/substituted. |
| Genuinely fresh holdout | Passes. |
| Earlier reuse of an unrelated non-holdout population | Passes; the rule is scoped rather than a global reuse prohibition. |

Every positive remains `SCIENTIFIC_INTEGRITY_CONSISTENT` only, with operational, paper, live and Risk authorization false. Trials erased before trusted acceptance or activity outside EdgeLab's evidence universe remain unknowable locally.

## Q02 disposition — PARTIALLY_REMEDIATED

The structured commitment is a substantial fix. Against a fixed valid assessment, malformed/non-object records, missing or extra fields, altered authority ID, stale generation, assessment digest, current-state digest, experiment identity, or claim-reference identity all reject. Changing commitment ID, timestamp or limitations without recomputing the self-digest also rejects. A replay against a changed assessment, claim or state rejects.

The self-digest correctly provides content integrity only. With a recomputed digest, alternate commitment IDs, ordinary past timestamps and alternate limitations verify because no authenticated external expectation supplies those values. The identical commitment can be verified repeatedly because local verification is stateless. A wholly forged, internally consistent assessment/commitment pair also verifies. These results are expected under the documented boundary: the function does not authenticate the authority, resolve the state digest to a trusted state, prove uniqueness, persist replay state, establish key custody, or prove atomic durable storage. Risk must supply those controls.

Q03 is narrower and local. `validate_record` invokes the shared clock checker, but `committed_at` is absent from `COMPLETED_TIMES`. Consequently an attacker can set `committed_at` to `2999-01-01T00:00:00Z`, recompute `commitment_sha256`, and pass `verify_authority_commitment(..., now=...)`. The schema proves date-time syntax and the self-digest proves the attacker-selected content; neither establishes that a future commitment already occurred. The minimum fix is to include `committed_at` in completed-time validation and add owner coverage for future commitment rejection. Quant should also document that commitment-ID uniqueness and same-claim replay detection require an authenticated durable authority/Risk registry.

## Risk evidence and remaining trust boundary

After Q03 is corrected, the structured record gives Risk unambiguous material for policy: authority ID, generation, commitment ID/time, assessment digest, accepted-state digest, experiment identity, exact claim-reference digest, limitations and self-digest. It still does not prove authority authenticity, key custody, adapter honesty, controller authentication, true atomicity, durable external storage, global commitment-ID uniqueness or replay prevention. A self-consistent forged record is not authenticated evidence. Risk must resolve the named authority and state through its own trusted channel and persist/check commitment identity and generation.
